{{Top|leg}}
'''Oomsh-fruit''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. In circa [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a bag of rotten, unpitted oomsh-fruit was among some rubbish that rained onto the [[Heroes of Cularin]]&mdash;a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]&mdash;while the agents were in the recycling district of the [[Darkside (sector)|Darkside sector]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
